Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses [A]Service Description : South Central Railway invites Open tender through GeM portal fr om eligible agencies for the printing and supply of Working Time Table Books (WTT-81) which are essential for systemic functioning of Railwa y. Working Time Table Book (WTT-81), published by Railways for Tra in Operations. This is used for Railway internal working and not for circ ulation in general public or any entity other than Railways. The Service provider should be able to print and supply within 15 days maximum . The Service Provider has to provide assistance in formatting , pag e setting , designing (if required) , printing, binding and delivery to loc ations intimated by Consignee. I. General conditions: The General conditions and Technical Specifications for SCR Working Timetable-81 is as under: 1. The draft copies of WTT-81 will be provided in MS Word, Exce l, Jpeg format only, the cover page of the book is to be designed by the firm, subject to approval from this office. The printer may compose the data in any suitable application software for better p rinting output but the size should not be less than A-4 and A-3.

2. Firm should have trained DTP staff for taking the above work simultaneously for all the three divisions in editing the data in MS office. Firm should have sufficient DTP Operators, Computers, Pri nters, Scanners etc., for printing and publication of WTT booklets. 3. High-quality printing is mandatory. 4. Total number of booklets is 11,834. 5. The approximate timeline for printing and supply should be mentioned in the quotation for printing of the above booklets and supply to the destinations such as Secunderabad (for Secunderab ad Division, Hyderabad Division and Rail Nilayam),Nanded, Visak hapatnam and Delhi. 6. The successful tenderer should be prepared to increase or de crease the number of copies by up to 30% based on the advice of Railways, within the delivery period. 7. The quotation should include a detailed cost breakup of all th e activities for preparation of above booklets. Parts A and B will be printed on white paper with black ink on 2. both sides of the paper (division-specific content). Part C will be printed both sides on yellow paper using black ink. All parts will be printed in A4 size. The cover pages will be printed in multi colour on both sides, 3. on a 170 GSM Indian Art Paper (Multi colour, gloss laminated). It will feature content in both English and Hindi. The main con tent of the booklet will be primarily in English, with Hindi used optionally whenever necessary. Maps and specific railway information will be printed in multi 4. colour on 80 GSM Indian Art Paper. Timetables and specific railway information will be printed on 5. 56-60 GSM map litho paper or similar. Collec tion of manuscripts/artwork and design from the Dy.COM/Coa ching will be the responsibility of the firm upon receipt of the purchase order. The firm must also handle all proofreading at every stage, and ensure that all corrections are carried out. A ny errors will be the responsibility of the firm. Confidentiality is paramount. The Working Timetable Boo 8. klet (WTT-81), is an internal document for Railway operations and is not intended for public circulation. The firm must main tain strict secrecy and is responsible for any omissions or erro rs caused by its personnel. A sample of the previous WTT will be provided for reference a 9.

nd must be returned after the job is completed. The firm should have well experience/equipped with workflow 10. in Word, Excel, Tables, Page maker, Illustrator or other releva nt applications. As the train timings may be changed till the l ast minute, the successful tenderer must be prepared for suc h changes and ensure timely delivery of the Working Timetab le to the satisfaction of the Railway Administration. Editing i n the documents to be done by the trained DTP staff o f your firm only. Binding should be of the “Perfect Binding” type. The printer m 11. ust ensure that all pages are properly glued during binding, w ith no loose sheets. The side cuttings should be neat, and qua lity should be maintained throughout the supply. Care should be taken to maintain the quality of binding throughout the su pply. The cover page should wrap around the entire width of the booklet. All the finished WTT-81 books should be packed in cartons ac 12. cording to its size and to be shipped as mentioned above.
